sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies a pressure state (prohibits switching with any surviving player in a Guild Battle) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ether Charge State (when the same Unison Attack is performed consecutively, Ether Charge State is removed and a Burst Skill activates).
-Applies Heartless Collapse (increases Ability Powerof damage taken by 30, increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 30, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.

-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Heartless Collapse (increases Ability Powerof damage taken by 30, increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 30, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Stun and Beguilement Resistance Up by 50

[A-un] Goga & Inga or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
